changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
create or alter view graph.AssetNodeKeyPath WITH SCHEMABINDING as select ID, Uid, Class, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, Segments, graph.GetKeyPath(Segments) as KeyPath, State, UpdatedOn from graph.AssetNode GO
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_GraphAssetNodeKeyPath') BEGIN create unique clustered index CIX_GraphAssetNodeKeyPath on graph.AssetNodeKeyPath (ID) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNodeKeyPath_KeyPath') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_GraphAssetNodeKeyPath_DisplayPath on graph.AssetNodeKeyPath (KeyPath) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNodeKeyPath_Uid') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_GraphAssetNodeKeyPath_Uid on graph.AssetNodeKeyPath (Uid) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNodeKeyPath_AssetType') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_GraphAssetNodeKeyPath_AssetType on graph.AssetNodeKeyPath (AssetTypeID asc) END
